Package client

Class ActiveOrdersController

java.lang.Object
client.ActiveOrdersController
public class ActiveOrdersController extends Object
The ActiveOrdersController class is responsible for managing the user's active orders. It interacts with the server to fetch, display, and update the status of orders in the client-side application.

This class provides functionalities such as:

  • Loading active orders for the current user.
  • Accepting delivery for an order and handling potential refunds for late deliveries.
  • Refreshing the list of active orders.

Example usage:

 
 ActiveOrdersController controller = new ActiveOrdersController();
 controller.setClient(clientInstance);
 controller.setUser(currentUser);
